programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences
programmes.d: A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
programmes.d: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room
programmes.d: Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programmes.d: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves
programmes.d: Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programmes.d: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me
programmes.d: A singer's song becomes tragically real.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
programmes.d: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programmes.d: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
programmes.d: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programmes.d: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
programmes.d: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
programmes.d: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programmes.t: The Faculty
programmes.d: En gruppe af en lille bys gymnasieelever opdager, at deres lærere er kontrolleret af tankekontrollerende rumvæsner. Fra et smart manuskript af Kevin Williamson (SCREAM) og instrueret af action-eksperten Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programmes.t: Shivers
programmes.d: A cult favorite, Shivers is David Cronenberg's feature-length debut about parasites invading a luxury apartment complex and turning its residents into violent, sex-crazed maniacs.

programmes.t: Saw 7
programmes.d: Verdens mest sete serie af horrorfilm vender tilbage for at lægge den sidste bloddryppende brik til det skræmmende puslespil. Saw 7 leverer 11 ondskabsfulde dødsfælder, utallige isnende gys og et klimaks, du aldrig vil glemme.

programmes.t: Rapture-Palooza
programmes.d: Efter "The Rapture" må et ungt par overliste Antikrist og redde det, der er tilbage af deres ødelagte verden i denne løsslupne, stjernebesatte komedie i dommedagsproportioner.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Our Selina is Dying
programmes.d: A young woman, Debra, comes to live with her mysterious family, including the dying patriarch Selena. After Selena clutches Debra's hand firmly leaving an odd spot on it, Debra begins to age very fast while Selena rejuvenates.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Call
programmes.d: A lonely man accidentally phones the wrong number and finds an intriguing female to whom he grows attached. When she refuses to meet him, he investigates and finds the phone in a museum next to the statue of a woman.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Trance
programmes.d: A scam artist purports to channel the spirit of Delos, a former inhabitant of Atlantis. Together with a partner, he makes a living off of it.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Acts of Terror
programmes.d: A woman terrorized by her abusive husband finds some small consolation in a statue of a dog given to her by her sympathetic sister

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: Twenty-Twenty Vision
programmes.d: Newly promoted bank loan officer Warren Cribbens cracks his eyeglasses and discovers he can see the future through them. Faced with seeing the future of the farmers whose farms he must foreclose on, Warren can't bring himself to foreclose.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programmes.d: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programmes.t: New Twilight Zone: The Trunk
programmes.d: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
programmes.d: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programmes.d: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
programmes.d: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programmes.d: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programmes.d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box

programmes.t: The Twilight Zone: The Masks
programmes.d: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.
